method: NOAA/NWS heat-index categories mapped to five underlying platform bands
warning: Screening guidance only; not an official IMD warning or a medical diagnosis. Local authorities may use different thresholds.

levels.label: Low
levels.action: Maintain normal hydration and sun awareness.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.action: Take breaks and increase hydration during prolonged exposure.

levels.label: High
levels.action: Limit strenuous outdoor activity and seek shade or cooling.

levels.label: Severe
levels.action: Avoid prolonged exposure; check on heat-sensitive people.

levels.label: Extreme
levels.action: Avoid outdoor exposure where possible and follow official emergency guidance.
